features: 55W Dual Port Car Charging: Charge two devices simultaneously with the boAt 55W dual port car charger—equipped with 30W USB-C and 25W USB-A ports.

12-Layer Smart IC Protection: Worried about charging your devices in extreme heat during long drives? Equipped with a multi-layer integrated circuit (IC) safety system for protection against overheating, overvoltage, overcurrent and short circuits
QC, PD and PPS Advanced Charging Protocols: Supports advanced charging protocols—PD, QC, and PPS for faster and safer charging for multiple devices charging simultaneously.
Ultra-Compact and Lightweight: Minimalistic and lightweight, this car charger fits perfectly into your car’s socket. It is ideal for both short commutes and cross-country drives.
High Durability with Scratch & Heat Resistance: Made to withstand daily wear with a durable, scratch-resistant body. It looks as premium as it performs.
description: From daily commutes to weekend getaways, stay charged with the boAt 55W Dual Port Car Charger. Delivering 55W fast charging, it supports PD, QC, and PPS advanced charging protocols—making it ideal for phones, tablets, and even USB-C laptops. With dual output ports, USB-C 30W and USB-A 25W, you can charge two devices at the same time. Its smart IC chip offers 12-layer protection from overheating, overcurrent, and short circuits—so you can charge worry-free even on bumpy roads. Designed for everyday convenience, its ultra-compact build fits flush into any car socket without adding clutter. Plus, the heat- and scratch-resistant surface means it stays looking fresh no matter how often it’s plugged in and pulled out. Built for life on the move, this charger is universally compatible and comes with a 1-year warranty for total peace of mind. Power your drives, the smart way—with boAt.
